title: Bahria Community Centre Campus, Karachi | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Bahria Community Centre Campus, located in Karachi, Pakistan. Address: Pakistan Navy Community Centre, Majeed SRE. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Karachi as the city.
